explication: Experiential combines an OpenAI-compatible model gateway with tooling that turns agent traces into evaluated and optimized routers. The main workflow is: capture or ingest traces, build project data, simulate and evaluate candidate behavior, then fit and serve a router. Separate branches cover gateway setup and governance, judge calibration, and model fine-tuning. The graph emphasizes documented workflows and relationships visible in the supplied source index; many implementation files were not sampled, so uncertain internal calls are omitted.
